import sys
from collections import deque
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
m = int(input())
graph = [[]] * (n + 1)
for _ in range(m):
    a, b = map(int, input().split())
    graph[a].append(b)

visited = [False] * (n + 1)
q = deque([1])
visited[1] = True
count = 0
while q:
    v = q.popleft()
    for w in graph[v]:
        if not visited[w]:
            visited[w] = True
            count += 1
            q.append(w)
print(count)
